source_type_note: Public pages and retrieval observations; not traffic or ranking data.

sources.title: LinkedIn company job alerts
sources.supports: Primary help page supports company-specific alerts as an existing alternative. It does not establish comparative freshness or our ranking prospects.

sources.title: LinkedIn job alerts
sources.supports: Primary help page describes alerts using search criteria and delivery settings.

sources.title: Huntr job tracker
sources.supports: Primary product documentation describes application boards and supporting organizational tools; category overlap, not a hands-on comparison.

sources.title: Teal job tracker guide
sources.supports: Primary product documentation describes saved jobs, statuses, notes, dates and follow-ups. Do not transfer these features to Job Seek.

sources.title: JobBeacon career-page monitor
sources.supports: Inspected vendor page advertises company-career monitoring, keyword/location filters and email alerts. Direct-source monitoring is not an uncontested position. Vendor performance/comparison claims not verified.

sources.title: FirstPost career-page alerts
sources.supports: Inspected vendor page advertises career-page monitoring, personalized alerts and exclusion rules across several languages. Coverage and speed claims not verified.

sources.title: Visualping website monitoring
sources.supports: Primary vendor explanation of monitoring websites; a horizontal substitute for manually checking career pages.

sources.title: France Travail alerts
sources.supports: Primary public-service guidance describes personalized job alerts, illustrating a native French alternative and vocabulary.

sources.title: LinkedIn Italian job alerts
sources.supports: Search-returned official terminology: avvisi di offerte di lavoro. Supports language choice, not search volume.

sources.title: LinkedIn German job alerts
sources.supports: Search-returned official terminology: Jobbenachrichtigungen. Supports vocabulary testing, not demand estimates.

sources.title: Target-company monitoring question
sources.supports: Directly inspected individual question from a creative professional about monitoring a target-company list and irrelevant recommendations. Anecdote only; promotional reply excluded.

sources.title: Keyword Planner metric definitions
sources.supports: Official documentation: monthly search estimates depend on close variants, date/location/network settings; competition is advertiser competition, not organic SEO difficulty.

sources.title: Search Console query dimension
sources.supports: Official documentation: query data describes searches leading to site visibility; anonymized queries are omitted. A site with few impressions cannot reveal total market demand.

sources.title: Google people-first content guidance
sources.supports: Official guidance supports original useful content and purpose; used to reject one thin page per generated query.

sources.title: Job Seek homepage
sources.supports: Public positioning centers selected companies, filters, alerts and application tracking. Search retrieval can lag deployment; current code confirms feature details.
